name: What specific rental repair challenges do property owners face in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: What specific rental repair challenges do property owners face in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior freeze-thaw cycles and severe weather across Denver, Aurora, and Parker frequently cause interior complications in rental properties. Rapid temperature shifts stress window framing, causing drywall cracks around door frames, while freezing conditions can lead to hidden pipe leaks that ruin baseboards and drywall. Landlords in these areas often prioritize durable tile, insulated subfloors, and moisture-resistant drywall repairs during turnovers to withstand local weather conditions and seasonal shifts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Denver-area rentals often face interior drywall cracking, subfloor shifting, and moisture damage caused by seasonal freeze-thaw cycles and extreme outdoor temperature swings.
